is_anopheles.evidence: Adults of Anopheles gambiae s.l. were reared from field-collected larvae and identified as An. gambiae and An. coluzzii (Page 1, Abstract; Page 3, Results).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for the Vgsc 1014F (L995F) kdr mutation using PCR according to Martinez-Torres et al. 1998 (Page 3, Methods; Page 4, Discussion).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 4 reports sample sizes and allele frequencies of the Kdr mutation in An. gambiae s.l.: Akoun (N=100, R=1, S=0) and Ebabodo (N=100, R=1, S=0), with text stating 100% of survivors tested carried the mutation (Page 1, Abstract; Page 4, Table 4).

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae were collected in December 2019 and February 2020 from natural larval habitats in Akoun and Ebabodo, Ayos, southern Cameroon (Page 2, Methodology).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article presenting original field collection, bioassay, and PCR data (Pages 1-4).

sub_country_location.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected at two specific sites in Ayos city: Akoun (3°54'102"N, 12°31'054"E) and Ebabodo (3°54'295"N, 12°31'631"E) in Cameroon (Page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito larvae collections took place in December 2019 and February 2020 (Page 2, Mosquito collection and treatment).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Original field survey conducted in Ayos city with no mention of data sharing from external databases or networks.

supplement.evidence: All relevant data (bioassays, species ID, and kdr frequencies) are contained within the main manuscript.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility and the frequency of the Vgsc 1014F kdr mutation in Anopheles coluzzii and An. gambiae collected from urban (Akoun) and peri-urban (Ebabodo) sites in Ayos, southern Cameroon between December 2019 and February 2020. WHO tube tests showed resistance to DDT, permethrin, and deltamethrin. Genotyping of bioassay survivors showed 100% fixation of the 1014F resistant allele.
